intent.raw: invoke refresh after selecting explicit pre/post adjudication layers
intent.objective: Replace only the blocked generation-2 L2/L3 continuation with a three-layer adjudication protocol and deterministic v1 compatibility projection.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The refreshed continuation is serialized because each immutable output is the next SWU's sole accepted input boundary.

boundaries.contract: Execute exactly one selected refreshed SWU and return structured evidence before the next unit becomes ready.
Reference parent F3 and M1/M2 by stable handle; never rewrite them or derive target propositions from outcomes.
Generate a parent-valid projection while leaving evaluator code and outcome tables unchanged.
No receipt or verdict decides identity, type, relationship, pattern, candidate, activation, or promotion state.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Only selected SWU writes its declared contract, runtime, evidence, test, and run paths.
Results are new; generation index is append-only after all prior gates pass.

steps.name: Author and validate proposal-only refresh package
stop_conditions: block if the refresh applies target mutations without approval or reopens completed L0/L1 evidence

steps.name: Implement overlay contract and compatibility materializer

outputs.ref: overlay schema, validator, materializer, negative vectors, and focused test

stop_conditions: block layer collapse, changed parent explanation/prediction, combined coordinate, partial-as-explained, nondeterminism, or protected-byte drift

steps.name: Freeze adjudication overlay and compatibility projection

inputs.ref: accepted parent, M1, M2, contract, and materializer handles

stop_conditions: block outcome-optimized cell, hidden partial/dispute, dropped uncertainty, target-provenance failure, or evaluation attempt

steps.name: Evaluate compatibility projection and append generation 2

inputs.ref: accepted layer and compatibility projection handles

outputs.ref: F3 result, successor suite result, provenance manifest, and second generation-index entry

stop_conditions: block projection drift, non-total outcome, wrong predecessor, duplicate append, replay drift, or authority-bearing route

steps.name: Independently replay temporal layers and close

inputs.ref: all layer, projection, result, and generation handles

outputs.ref: fresh-process replay, target-provenance audit, authority audit, and closeout receipt

stop_conditions: block any byte, handle, replay, provenance, receipt, source-boundary, uncertainty, or authority failure

gates.condition: Proposal-only refresh is explicitly selected for Task Session execution before target mutation.
Overlay contract and materializer reject layer collapse and produce deterministic parent-valid projections.
Twelve separate cells, target provenance, uncertainty, review states, and handles are total and valid.
Frozen evaluator returns a total outcome and generation 2 appends once after the exact generation-1 tail.
No artifact claims identity, type, relationship, pattern, candidate, activation, or promotion authority.

promotion_guardrails: Compatibility projection is an evaluator input, not an authority artifact.
No calibration result establishes Page identity or a compound DS-D1 kind.
No harness or overlay result establishes framework or cross-domain portability.
No suite verdict directly admits a pattern, candidate, relationship, activation, or promotion.
